Frequently asked

Before the first call

You do not need a perfect brief. A clear description of the sales challenge is enough to begin.

What should I bring to the first conversation?

Come prepared to discuss your offer, target market, current sales team, pipeline goals, sales cycle, existing outbound activity, and where execution is getting stuck.

Is the first conversation a sales demo?

It is a practical fit conversation. The goal is to understand the sales motion and determine whether an SDR, AE, or connected team model makes sense.

Can I contact Capital Generations without booking a call?

Yes. Email contact@capitalgenerations.com, call 631-877-1393, send a WhatsApp message, or use the contact form.
